scope: Read-only host pointer gate and TransitionView binding review for Build18 hardware-input regression. Production files and active Unity project untouched; exact live cause awaits Root hardware probe.

proven_host_branches.rule: player missing, automated, ExternalInputReplay or IsTransitioning skips ReadOriginalInput.
Paused, state!=4 or OriginalTransitionBlocksPointerInput causes every-frame ResetPointers and returns before pointer acquisition, ApplyToRig, keyboard movement and kick.
TransitionView root Image isActiveAndEnabled && raycastTarget blocks globally. It does not use a real screen raycast, Canvas.enabled or CanvasGroup filtering.
OverButton returns true when ANY hit has a Selectable ancestor, including behind the actual top hit. This differs from UGUI and can suppress otherwise capturable pointers.
Drag is forwarded only for a pointer that succeeded initial PointerDown capture. Holding a button after a rejected Down does not recapture until another Down.

transition_resource_facts.source_initial: GameObject active, Image.enabled=true, Image.color.a=0, raycastTarget=true. Thus transparent root Image can initially intercept every pointer.
transition_resource_facts.slide_out: Original TransitionScreen_SlideOut disables root Image.m_Enabled at t=0 and holds0 through t=.5. It disables internal MainContainer at t=.25. Root Image release is not deferred to .25 or .5.
transition_resource_facts.initialize: Original initialize clip also disables Image at t=0 but no source TransitionView method plays it; helper intentionally does not fabricate initialize playback.
transition_resource_facts.generated_validation: Both workspace and D:/codex-bloody-workspace-20261028 generated copies contain 38 remapped Image references, zero original DLL GUID references; m_FloatCurves and genericBindings both preserved.
transition_resource_facts.competing_controller: OriginalUIFlowSource has no TransitionView row; source Animator has no runtime controller. No second TransitionView controller found in examined recovery code.
transition_resource_facts.conditional_cause: If actual state4, IsTransitioning=false and current SlideOut sampled beyond .5 but root Image remains enabled, host global predicate will permanently zero pointers. That would implicate actual Playable evaluation/binding/lifecycle, not missing source keys or unmapped GUIDs. Static inspection alone does not establish Image live value.

over_button_source_evidence.BaseInputModule.cs:130: FindFirstRaycast returns the first nonnull gameObject in ordered candidates.
over_button_source_evidence.PointerInputModule.cs:295: RaycastAll -> FindFirstRaycast -> pointerCurrentRaycast, then clear all results.
over_button_source_evidence.StandaloneInputModule.cs:634: ProcessMousePress dispatches pointer-down and click handling only up the currentOverGo hierarchy.
over_button_source_evidence.counterexample: Ordered hits [foreground joystick graphic without Selectable, covered Button graphic] => current OverButton true, source current target remains foreground joystick graphic.
over_button_source_evidence.minimal_correction: Use first valid hit and its actual event target/ancestor instead of scanning lower hits. Keep pointer capture after successful Down; releases are still required. Do not treat a disabled/noninteractable control policy as automatically proven source behavior without checking original event handling.

launcher_exclusion: Both workspace and integration playtest BAT launch Build18 mode0 with independent save and no recoveryCapture/validation flags; these BATs do not explicitly set automated or ExternalInputReplay.

probe_gap.OriginalMatchReplay: Sets ExternalInputReplay=true and drives separate adapter.PointerDown/Drag/ApplyToRig directly; bypasses host Update, global transition gate, OverButton and raw Unity mouse sampling.
probe_gap.OriginalOnboardingReplay: Sets ExternalInputReplay=true; tutorial uses direct Button.onClick; Practice uses separate adapter.ApplyToRig. It explicitly reports desktop hardware input unverified.
probe_gap.implication: Previous numeric input checks and full combat replay never established working actual desktop mouse input.

minimal_live_discriminator: Record actual IsTransitioning, state, Paused, automated, ExternalInputReplay, Application.isFocused, raw mouse Down/Held and Input.mousePosition.
Record Transition root Image.enabled/isActiveAndEnabled/raycastTarget, active state, current clip, actual Playable time/weights/isPlaying and parent Canvas/CanvasGroup state.
On each actual Down record sorted hit paths and first hit, OverButton decision, capture result, then pre/post adapter nubs and rig input flags.
Check A/D and Space in same state4: global reset gate suppresses them as well, whereas OverButton affects only capture.
A fix needs actual raw-input-to-host capture and observable body motion plus UI button behavior; no direct adapter injection should count as this acceptance.
